blocks.content: On the pull request page, GitHub shows you exactly what will change — the base branch (where it goes) and the compare branch (where it comes from), plus a full diff.
Write a clear title. In the description, explain what you changed and why. If the PR addresses an open issue, add Closes #42 — GitHub will automatically close the issue when the PR merges.

blocks.alt: GitHub PR form showing base and compare branch selectors, a title field, description, and file diff

blocks.content: The maintainer reviews your changes, leaves comments if needed, and when satisfied — clicks Merge pull request.
If they request changes, make the fix on your branch and push again. The new commit appears automatically in the open PR. No need to close and reopen.

blocks.alt: GitHub PR showing the purple Merged badge and the completed merge commit
